blocker.summary: The pre-authorized harness cannot accept these ten rows without me authoring four classes of evaluation truth that the §173/§174 instrument does not contain and no human adjudicated — one of which IS the scoring target this authorization names.
whatTheInstrumentContains: one binary HUMAN_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED verdict per row

whatTheHarnessAdditionallyRequires.why: ExpertAnalysisInput carries it and it constrains what the model may raise
gate A.2 "every row is structurally scoreable" runs validateCohortRow, whose TOTALITY RULE requires these three buckets to be disjoint and to cover allowedHazardFamilies exactly
required by validateCohortRow for any row that owes a clarification

whatTheHarnessAdditionallyRequires.field: expectation.truth.missingFact (plus both branches and both outcomes)
whatTheHarnessAdditionallyRequires.why: THIS IS THE SCORING TARGET. The authorization scores a REQUIRED row correct only if Expert emits a clarification that addresses "the material unresolved fact represented by that row".

blocker.decisiveFact: MATERIAL_UNRESOLVED_FACTS is null on 10 of 10 rows in the frozen §174 truth record, as are EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY_CONCERN, TEMPORAL_SCOPE_CONCERN, COUNTERFACTUAL_DECISION_CHANGE and HUMAN_RATIONALE. The product owner supplied the binary verdict and confidence only. The sole existing per-row statement of the material unresolved fact is the authoring-side PAIR-MAP INTENDED_SEMANTIC_DIFFERENCE, written by this model in §173.
blocker.whyIDidNotSupplyIt: Authoring the missing-fact statement and then scoring this model family output against it is the closed loop refused since §162 — and §169 is the direct precedent: when a human reviewed whether clarifications addressed the owed fact, 4 of 12 came back only partially correct, a distinction no model-authored target would have produced. The provenance limitation recorded in §174 already means a strong score is hard to interpret; scoring against a model-authored target as well would leave nothing an independent reader could check.
blocker.whyIDidNotBypassTheValidator: Gate A.2 is a protected verification gate. Repository policy forbids bypassing, mocking, relaxing or disabling a gate to obtain a result, and a placeholder truth key passed to it would be exactly that even though the truth key provably never reaches the model.

whatWouldHaveBeenMeasurableAnyway.SILENCE_PRECISION: EXACT AND MECHANICAL — frozen truth says nothing is owed on a SILENCE row, so any clarification emitted there is a failure by definition, with no semantic judgement needed
whatWouldHaveBeenMeasurableAnyway.REQUIRED_RECALL_LOOSE: MECHANICAL UPPER BOUND — whether any clarification was emitted
whatWouldHaveBeenMeasurableAnyway.REQUIRED_RECALL_STRICT: NOT MODEL-DETERMINABLE — needs the missing-fact statement per row
whatWouldHaveBeenMeasurableAnyway.note: this is offered as the shape of a reduced run, not as a result. Nothing was executed.

twoResolutionsForTheOwner.title: supply the ten missing-fact statements
twoResolutionsForTheOwner.what: for each of the five REQUIRED rows, one sentence naming the material unresolved fact, and for each SILENCE row a confirmation that nothing is owed. Then the full strict scoring rule in this authorization becomes executable as written.
twoResolutionsForTheOwner.cost: no provider spend; human effort only

twoResolutionsForTheOwner.title: authorize a reduced run with the strict half deferred
twoResolutionsForTheOwner.what: preregister a uniform hazard vocabulary and jurisdiction identical across all ten rows, report SILENCE_PRECISION exactly and REQUIRED_RECALL as a bounded range, and emit a human adjudication packet pairing every emitted clarification with its row for the strict determination — the §147 precedent in this repository.
twoResolutionsForTheOwner.caveat: still requires authorizing a hazard-vocabulary choice this model would make, and still cannot produce BALANCED_ACCURACY as a point estimate

recommendation: Option A. It is the only one that makes the authorization executable as written, costs nothing, and keeps the scoring target human-supplied — which is what makes any resulting number checkable by someone who was not in this session.
